newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends marginally weaker vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends marginally weaker vs dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed marginally weaker at 43.7500/7570 to the dollar on Sunday in interbank trading that saw some mid-session purchases for the U.S. currency to clear import bills, dealers said.
This compares with the previous close at 43.7480/7530.
The local unit was quoted mostly steady at 43.7450/7550 per dollar in early trade but slipped by midday amid a sudden rise in dollar demand.
The interbank call money rates closed softer at 5.5 to 6.0 percent against a previous six to seven percent in a liquid market.
